ns1:item.ns1:title: Earth Foundation Models outperform traditional deep learning architectures for coastal ecosystem semantic segmentation and large-scale habitat mapping
ns1:item.dc:title: Earth Foundation Models outperform traditional deep learning architectures for coastal ecosystem semantic segmentation and large-scale habitat mapping
ns1:item.dc:creator: Daniel Jacome Jianghao Wang Yong Ge a State Key Laboratory of Resources and Environmental Information System, Institute of Geographic Sciences and Natural Resources Research, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing, Chinab College of Resources and Environment, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing, Chinac Jiangsu Center for Collaborative Innovation in Geographical Information Resource Development and Application, Nanjing, Chinad Key Laboratory of Poyang Lake Wetland and Watershed Research Ministry of Education, School of Geography and Environment, Jiangxi Normal University, Nanchang, ChinaDaniel Jacome received his Ph.D. in Cartography and Geographic Information Systems from the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences. He focuses on the precision and efficiency of Earth foundation models for environmental monitoring. Jianghao Wang is a Professor at the State Key Laboratory of Resources and Environmental Information System, Institute of Geographic Sciences & Natural Resources Research, Chinese Academy of Sciences. His research focuses on the GIScience and remote sensing, and Big Earth Data. Yong Ge is a Professor at the Institute of Geographic Sciences and Natural Resources Research, Chinese Academy of Sciences, and Jiangxi Normal University, China. Her research focuses on spatial statistics and applications.
